updates.title: 发布稳定性修复与文档归并
items: 关于页提供中英文图文教程，覆盖任务、计时、日程、森林和备份。
修复取消资源下载后文件流未关闭的问题，完善启动失败诊断。
合并未正式发布版本的更新与技术记录，统一文档链接和正式发布规则。
itemsEn: Open illustrated Chinese and English guides from About for tasks, focus, schedules, forest and backups.
Close file streams when resource downloads are cancelled and retain startup failure diagnostics.
Consolidate unpublished changes and technical records, with consistent documentation links and release rules.

updates.title: 本地专注森林、成就与任务提醒
items: 恢复原版专注森林、阳光收取和详细攻略，森林数据保存在本机。
新增铜、银、金三档本地成就，达成后直接获得阳光奖励。
取消每日阳光收取上限，修复连续收取与位置刷新。
修复网页标签图标，并突出圆形成就入口。
阳光沿原版路径飞向树木，收取失败可重试，兼容减少动态效果。
任务到时提醒优先展示，已读或完成后及时清除红点，保留版本更新提示。
可选的浏览器存储持久化授权在后台执行，不再阻塞应用启动。
updates.titleEn: Local Focus forest, achievements and task reminders
itemsEn: Restore the original Focus forest, sunlight collection and detailed guide, with local storage.
Earn bronze, silver and gold local achievements with immediate sunlight rewards.
Remove the daily collection limit and fix sunlight collection and position refresh.
Fix the browser tab icon and make the achievements entry a prominent circular button.
Animate sunlight along the original flight path, retry failed collections and respect reduced motion.
Show task reminders before release history and clear read or completed reminder badges while retaining release notifications.
Request optional browser storage persistence in the background without blocking startup.

updates.title: 日程与提示样式优化
items: 日程创建任务时为空名称提供清晰的表单提示。
底部提示适配浅色和深色主题，并自动渐隐。
itemsEn: Show an inline message when a schedule task has no name.
Adapt bottom notices to light and dark themes and fade them out automatically.

updates.title: 系统清单排序与用户名存储修复
items: 系统清单改用界面内拖动，禁放位置不再触发浏览器文本搜索，主动移动行显示在动画上层。
清单管理取消自定义清单排序，自定义清单继续在主界面拖动。
新增恢复系统清单默认排序按钮，保留隐藏状态和自定义清单数据。
清理已停用的 NAME Cookie，用户名统一从本地存储读取。
updates.titleEn: System list ordering and username storage fixes
itemsEn: Use in-app dragging for system lists without browser text-search gestures, keeping the moved row above other rows.
Remove custom-list ordering from settings; continue reordering custom lists in the main view.
Restore the default system list order while preserving hidden states and custom-list data.
Remove the unused NAME browser cookie and read usernames from local storage.

updates.title: 清单排序反馈与本地兼容修复
items: 清单每行新增三条杠拖动手柄、排序动画和插入提示，拖动时不可放置的清单分组变灰。
改善背景音的多窗口交接；缺少 Web Locks 时说明兼容限制，保留试听与完成提示音。
本地昵称和头像直接通过数据服务保存，写入失败时正确反馈。
updates.titleEn: List ordering feedback and local compatibility fixes
itemsEn: Add visible three-bar drag handles, reorder animation and insertion feedback; dim lists in the unavailable group while dragging.
Improve background-audio handoff between windows; explain the fallback without Web Locks while retaining previews and completion sounds.
Save local names and avatars through the data service and report failed writes.

updates.title: 语言字体、功能整合与发布验收修复
items: 中文附带字体就绪后自动应用，英文优先系统西文字体，番茄钟保留官方字体。
按功能整合数据、备份、设置和主题服务，移除无效轮询与调试入口。
保留渐进启动和真实进度，界面就绪后显示，加载失败时可重试。
完善跨标签协同验收，提供跨平台便携包与 SHA256 校验。
updates.titleEn: Language fonts, feature consolidation and release verification
itemsEn: Apply bundled Chinese fonts when ready, prefer western system fonts in English, and retain official timer fonts.
Consolidate data, backup, settings and theme services, removing unused polling and debug controls.
Keep progressive startup and real progress, show the workspace when ready, and retry failed loads.
Improve cross-tab verification and provide portable packages with SHA256 verification.

updates.title: 语言选择、英文适配与通知授权
items: 通用设置新增跟随系统、简体中文和English，其他语言仅通过跟随系统启用。
本地界面、错误、历史更新和使用维护文档新增英语；缺失翻译回退合适语言，不显示键名。
新增主动通知授权和测试入口，统一纯本地功能定位与小组、森林设计方案。
updates.titleEn: Language selection, English support and notifications
itemsEn: Choose Follow system, Simplified Chinese or English in General settings. Other existing languages remain available through Follow system.
Use English local dialogs, errors, release notes and documentation, with readable fallbacks for missing translations.
Enable or test desktop notifications explicitly, and clarify the offline scope and group/forest design.

updates.title: 每日壁纸缓存与主题设置恢复
items: 每日壁纸优先使用缓存，过期时后台刷新，首次下载期间关闭设置仍会完成选择。
主题设置增加失败回滚和启动恢复，避免图片、激活状态与主题名称写入不一致。
统一维护文档中的未完成工作与验收，清理已完成旧项和重复计划。
updates.titleEn: Bing wallpaper cache and theme recovery
itemsEn: Switch to a cached Bing wallpaper immediately and refresh expired images in the background. Closing settings does not cancel the selection.
Recover interrupted theme changes and roll back failed writes without mixing image and activation settings.
Centralize open engineering and verification work, removing completed and duplicate entries.

updates.title: 主题切换与每日壁纸修复
items: Bing 下载与自动刷新完成后不再覆盖后选的主题，下载状态在设置界面持续可见。
经典主题切换立即同步背景、红色对钩和粉色边框，修复无法切回刚才经典主题的问题。
本地上传遵循最新选择；删除正在使用的本地主题后正确恢复默认主题。
updates.titleEn: Theme selection and daily wallpaper fixes
itemsEn: Bing downloads and automatic refreshes no longer override a later theme choice.
Classic backgrounds, checkmarks and borders update together; returning to the previous classic theme works.
Image uploads respect the latest selection, and deleting an active custom theme restores Leaf.

updates.title: 通知面板布局修复
items: 通知面板改为统一滚动，移除空提醒区域的固定占位，更新内容和任务提醒均可完整查看。
修复普通 Chromium 浏览器调整窗口时误用扩展存储接口的报错，保证窗口缩放后继续刷新布局。
保留固定标题，适配较小窗口及页面缩放，通知详情继续支持鼠标和键盘打开。
合并早期 patch.1 的两阶段报告，统一历史文档入口。
itemsEn: Updates and reminders share a scroll area without a fixed empty spacer.
Browser resizing no longer calls extension-only storage APIs.
Keep headings fixed and support small windows, zoom, mouse and keyboard interaction.
Consolidate the two historical patch.1 phases and documentation links.

updates.title: 多标签页初始化同步修复
items: 修复多个标签页同时打开时，部分页面的任务进度和专注统计未及时刷新的问题。
便携包补齐维护与历史文档，统一文档入口并修正内部链接。
现有任务、专注记录和设置继续保留，默认访问地址不变。
itemsEn: Prevent lost focus-record refresh events while another tab is still initializing.
Include maintenance and historical documents in portable archives and correct their links.
Keep existing tasks, focus records, settings and the default address.

updates.title: 多平台启动与便携发布
items: Windows、macOS 和 Linux 现在可以使用统一的启动方式，支持自动打开浏览器、自定义端口及无浏览器模式。
提供 ZIP 和 tar.gz 便携包，解压并安装 Node.js 后即可运行，无需安装应用依赖。
默认访问地址保持不变；升级时使用原有浏览器、主机名和端口即可继续使用本地数据。
itemsEn: Use a common launcher on Windows, macOS and Linux, with browser opening, custom ports and headless mode.
Download ZIP or tar.gz packages and run with Node.js; application dependencies do not need installation.
Keep the same browser, hostname and port to retain existing local data.
